finalText:
Big, but mostly mechanical. 1082 lines across 94 files.

Do not rename:

```
docs/openapi.yaml            5   public API contract, frozen
lib/serialize.js WIRE value  1   public JSON key
migrations/*.sql            61   12 already applied in prod
services/*/repo/*.js SQL   125   real column name, needs a migration
vendor/reporting-sdk        20   generated, vendor:refresh overwrites
```

That leaves roughly 1130 plain JS identifiers, safe to rename.

One catch. `insertOrder` writes `account_id` into the stored `payload` JSON.
